# Parish of the Dormition of the Mother of God

> A Russian Orthodox parish (Moscow Patriarchate) in Kovan, Singapore — the cathedral
> parish of the Diocese of Singapore and the seat of the Patriarchal Exarchate of
> South-East Asia. The Divine Liturgy is served morning and evening throughout the week.
> All are welcome.

This file summarises the site for language models and AI search engines. Replace
orthodox.sg with the real domain before publishing.

## About the parish
- Full name: Parish of the Dormition of the Mother of God (Приход Успения Пресвятой Богородицы)
- Tradition: Eastern Orthodox Christianity
- Jurisdiction: Russian Orthodox Church (Moscow Patriarchate), Diocese of Singapore; seat of the Patriarchal Exarchate of South-East Asia
- Founded: 12 October 2007
- Location: 110 Highland Road, Singapore 549190 — a house church, about 5 minutes on foot from Kovan MRT (North-East line)
- A new church is under construction at the Russian Cultural Centre (foundation stone laid November 2018) — the first Orthodox church to be built in Singapore. Until it is consecrated, services are held in the house church in Kovan.
- The parish is multi-ethnic (Russian-speakers, Singaporeans, and others) and deliberately keeps a quiet life; it does not proselytise.

## Worship
- Services are in Church Slavonic, with some hymns and readings in English; sermons in Russian and English.
- Rhythm: the early Divine Liturgy and evening services on most days; the All-Night Vigil before Sundays and feasts; molebens (services of supplication) and memorial services.
- Exact dates and times are published on the parish's public Google Calendar, shown on the website, and announced in the parish WhatsApp groups.

## Visiting (for newcomers)
- No special preparation is needed; you may come in, stand to one side, and pray with everyone.
- Modest dress (shoulders and knees covered). It is customary to stand; some seating is available.
- The Divine Liturgy lasts about 1.5–2 hours; you may enter or leave quietly at any time.
- Questions: WhatsApp +65 6462 2448.

## Confession and Holy Communion
- Holy Communion is given to Orthodox Christians who have prepared through prayer, fasting and Confession. Visitors and enquirers are welcome to come forward at the end of the service for a blessing and to receive the blessed bread (antidoron), and to speak with the priest.

## Supporting the parish
- The parish receives no government funding and rents its premises; about S$18,000 is needed each month for rent and running costs.
- PayNow UEN: T08SS0198H. OCBC Bank account: 591-405824-001 (account name: RUSSIAN ORTHODOX CHURCH).

## Languages available on the website
English, Russian, Chinese, Malay, Tamil, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Korean, Japanese, Filipino.

## Follow the service
- The full text of the Divine Liturgy of St John Chrysostom, in Church Slavonic and English side by side (searchable, with the tone of the week and the day's propers marked), is at https://orthodox.sg/liturgy.html
